exposure: fetal lies and presentations in twin pregnancies (cephalic vs. non-cephalic presentation of first or both twins)
outcome: actual mode of delivery (vaginal vs. cesarean section)
cohort: The study included 26,143 twin births in Norway between 1988 and 2018.
finding: More than half of women with a twin pregnancy had a successful vaginal delivery, with success being higher in parous women or when the first or both twins were in cephalic presentation.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery in twin pregnancies was more successful if the first or both twins were in cephalic presentation and in parous women, while planned cesarean section was more likely with non-cephalic presentations.
